name: Auto Input
description: Detects obstacles ahead of the player and automatically clicks, holds or spam-clicks to dodge them.

enabled.name: Enable Auto Input
enabled.description: Master switch. When off, the mod never touches your inputs.

lookahead.name: Lookahead (seconds)
lookahead.description: How far ahead (in level time) the bot looks for obstacles. Higher = safer planning, more CPU.

margin.name: Safety margin (units)
margin.description: Extra clearance added around every hazard when planning.

orbs.name: Use orbs
orbs.description: Automatically hit jump/gravity/dash orbs when a hazard lies shortly after them (experimental).

no-record.name: Don't save completions
no-record.description: If Auto Input clicked during an attempt, the completion is NOT submitted/saved (treated like a test run). Keeps leaderboards and your stats legit.
